premises: Co substitution in MnNiSi can lower the martensitic transition temperature (Tt).
Lowering Tt into the Curie-temperature window (CTW) enables a coupled magnetostructural transition with large ΔM.
Isostructural alloying can reinforce the bonding network and improve mechanical performance.
The stability of Ni2In and TiNiSi structures depends on covalent bonds, which can be altered by substitution.
